definitions.gloss: dead drunk; heavily intoxicated; blind drunk
definitions.explanation: A state of extreme drunkenness where one can barely function. Stronger than just being drunk — implies a complete loss of composure.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{泥酔|でいすい}して{動|うご}けなかった。
examples.english: He was dead drunk and couldn't move.

examples.japanese: {泥酔|でいすい}{状態|じょうたい}で{駅|えき}のホームで{寝|ね}ている{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There was someone passed out drunk on the station platform.

examples.japanese: {泥酔|でいすい}した{客|きゃく}がタクシーの{中|なか}で{暴|あば}れて、{運転手|うんてんしゅ}が{困|こま}っていた。
examples.english: A dead-drunk passenger was being rowdy in the taxi, and the driver was at a loss.

notes:
Literally "mud-drunk" — the {泥|どろ} (mud) character evokes the image of someone so drunk they are like mud, completely limp and unable to function. The verb form {泥酔|でいすい}する means "to get completely wasted."

DEGREES OF DRUNKENNESS (from mild to severe):
- ほろ{酔|よ}い (pleasantly tipsy)
- {酔|よ}っている (drunk)
- {泥酔|でいすい} (dead drunk)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泥酔|でいすい}{状態|じょうたい} (state of heavy intoxication)
- {泥酔|でいすい}{運転|うんてん} (driving while heavily intoxicated)
- {泥酔|でいすい}した{客|きゃく} (extremely drunk customer/patron)
